pages.text: $(item)config/redcircuit-common.toml$() can disable each ore and change generator outputs and machine costs.$(br2)Recipes use common $(item)c:$() tags, so tin, silver or brass from other mods work. Alloy recipes ($(item)redcircuit:alloying$()) can be edited with datapacks, KubeJS or CraftTweaker.
$(item)Jade$() shows signal levels, bundled channels, gate settings and generator output. $(item)JEI$() shows alloy recipes and info pages.
